g.text: Red: false alarms when there is no effect (α). Green: detections when the effect is real (power).

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Power belongs to a planned design AND an assumed effect. It is not the chance that the treatment works.
